question: Users already log into our dashboard. Can I make their credentials automatically fill in when they try API endpoints instead of manual copy-paste? We set JWT cookies - should we use that or the other flow? If we use the other option, who handles the authentication dance?
ground_truth: You can integrate Fern's API explorer with your existing authentication system using two approaches: 1) JWT Flow - you handle the entire auth flow in your dashboard and set a JWT cookie, then Fern reads that JWT cookie to automatically populate API keys in the explorer. This is ideal since you already set JWT cookies. 2) OAuth Flow - you provide Fern with OAuth credentials and Fern directly initiates and handles the OAuth handshake process, then uses the resulting token to populate API keys. The key difference is who manages the authentication: JWT lets you maintain full control and leverage your existing auth infrastructure, while OAuth delegates the handshake to Fern. Both approaches enable one-click endpoint testing without manual credential entry. Important note: API key injection is a premium feature available only for Pro and Enterprise plans.

metadata.cited_context: Fern can integrate with your authentication flow, allowing users to login and have their API key automatically populated with the click of a button. API key injection can work in two different ways depending on your company's authentication setup: JWT or OAuth. JWT Flow: You handle the entire auth flow and just give Fern a JWT cookie. OAuth Flow: You give Fern access, and Fern directly initiates the OAuth handshake process. This feature is available only for the Pro and Enterprise plans.
